class.name: AudioStream
class.description: Base class for audio streams. Audio streams are used for sound effects and music playback, and support WAV (via [AudioStreamWAV]), Ogg (via [AudioStreamOggVorbis]), and MP3 (via [AudioStreamMP3]) file formats. Every stream also carries optional track information such as [member title], [member artist], [member album] and [member cover]. It is read from the tags of the audio file (ID3, RIFF INFO, Vorbis comments) when the file is loaded or imported, unless [member ProjectSettings.audio/info/read_file_tags] is disabled. Use [method load_info] to read only the information of a file without loading its audio data. Empty strings and [code]0[/code] mean unknown.

method.name: _get_bar_beats
method.description: Override this method to return the bar beats of this stream.

method.name: _get_beat_count
method.description: Overridable method. Should return the total number of beats of this audio stream. Used by the engine to determine the position of every beat. Ideally, the returned value should be based off the stream's sample rate ([member AudioStreamWAV.mix_rate], for example).

method.name: _get_bpm
method.description: Overridable method. Should return the tempo of this audio stream, in beats per minute (BPM). Used by the engine to determine the position of every beat. Ideally, the returned value should be based off the stream's sample rate ([member AudioStreamWAV.mix_rate], for example).

method.name: _get_length
method.description: Override this method to customize the returned value of [method get_length]. Should return the length of this audio stream, in seconds.

method.name: _get_parameter_list
method.description: Return the controllable parameters of this stream. This array contains dictionaries with a property info description format (see [method Object.get_property_list]). Additionally, the default value for this parameter must be added tho each dictionary in "default_value" field.

method.name: _get_stream_name
method.deprecated: This method is not used by the engine.
method.description: Override this method to customize the name assigned to this audio stream.

method.name: _get_tags
method.description: Override this method to customize the tags for this audio stream. Should return a [Dictionary] of strings with the tag as the key and its content as the value. Commonly used tags include [code skip-lint]title[/code], [code skip-lint]artist[/code], [code skip-lint]album[/code], [code]tracknumber[/code], and [code]date[/code].

method.name: _has_loop
method.description: Override this method to return [code]true[/code] if this stream has a loop.

method.name: _instantiate_playback
method.description: Override this method to customize the returned value of [method instantiate_playback]. Should return a new [AudioStreamPlayback] created when the stream is played (such as by an [AudioStreamPlayer]).

method.name: _is_monophonic
method.description: Override this method to customize the returned value of [method is_monophonic]. Should return [code]true[/code] if this audio stream only supports one channel.

method.name: can_be_sampled
method.description: Returns if the current [AudioStream] can be used as a sample. Only static streams can be sampled.

method.name: generate_sample
method.description: Generates an [AudioSample] based on the current stream.

method.name: get_bitrate
method.description: Returns the average bitrate of the audio data in bits per second, or [code]0[/code] if unknown or not applicable (for example for generators). For [AudioStreamMP3] the tag bytes are not counted.

method.name: get_channel_count
method.description: Returns the number of channels of the audio data, or [code]0[/code] if unknown or not applicable (for example for [AudioStreamGenerator], playlists or [AudioStreamMicrophone]).

method.name: get_codec
method.description: Returns the name of the audio format: [code]"PCM"[/code], [code]"IMA ADPCM"[/code] or [code]"QOA"[/code] for [AudioStreamWAV], [code]"MP3"[/code], [code]"Vorbis"[/code] or [code]"Opus"[/code]. Returns an empty string for streams without a file format, such as generators, playlists and the microphone.

method.name: get_length
method.description: Returns the length of the audio stream in seconds. If this stream is an [AudioStreamRandomizer], returns the length of the last played stream. If this stream has an indefinite length (such as for [AudioStreamGenerator] and [AudioStreamMicrophone]), returns [code]0.0[/code].

method.name: get_sample_rate
method.description: Returns the sample rate of the audio data in Hz, or [code]0[/code] if unknown or not applicable (for example for generators, playlists or [AudioStreamMicrophone]).

method.name: instantiate_playback
method.description: Returns a newly created [AudioStreamPlayback] intended to play this audio stream. Useful for when you want to extend [method _instantiate_playback] but call [method instantiate_playback] from an internally held AudioStream subresource. An example of this can be found in the source code for [code]AudioStreamRandomPitch::instantiate_playback[/code].

method.name: is_meta_stream
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the stream is a collection of other streams, [code]false[/code] otherwise.

method.name: is_monophonic
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if this audio stream only supports one channel ([i]monophony[/i]), or [code]false[/code] if the audio stream supports two or more channels ([i]polyphony[/i]).

method.name: load_info

members.member: The album this track belongs to. Read from ID3 [code]TALB[/code], RIFF [code]IPRD[/code] or the Vorbis comment [code]ALBUM[/code]. Empty if unknown.
The artist of the whole album, which can differ from [member artist] on compilations. Read from ID3 [code]TPE2[/code] or the Vorbis comment [code]ALBUMARTIST[/code]. Empty if unknown.
The artist of this track. Read from ID3 [code]TPE1[/code], RIFF [code]IART[/code] or the Vorbis comment [code]ARTIST[/code]. Empty if unknown. Multiple values are joined with [code]", "[/code].

A free text comment. Read from ID3 [code]COMM[/code] (the one without description is preferred), RIFF [code]ICMT[/code] or the Vorbis comment [code]COMMENT[/code] or [code]DESCRIPTION[/code]. Empty if unknown.
The composer of this track. Read from ID3 [code]TCOM[/code], RIFF [code]IMUS[/code] or the Vorbis comment [code]COMPOSER[/code]. Empty if unknown.
The copyright notice. Read from ID3 [code]TCOP[/code], RIFF [code]ICOP[/code] or the Vorbis comment [code]COPYRIGHT[/code]. Empty if unknown.

The cover art of this track. If [member cover_data] is set, the texture is decoded from it on the first access and then cached, so call this where the texture is needed (for example on the main thread). Setting a texture by hand clears [member cover_data], and the texture is then saved with the resource itself. [code]null[/code] if there is no cover.

The encoded cover image (PNG, JPEG or WebP bytes) as stored in the file. Read from the ID3 [code]APIC[/code] frame (the front cover is preferred) or the Vorbis comment [code]METADATA_BLOCK_PICTURE[/code]. Setting it clears the cached [member cover]. Empty if there is no cover. Not shown in the inspector.

The total number of discs of the release. [code]0[/code] if unknown. Read from the part after the slash of ID3 [code]TPOS[/code] or from the Vorbis comments [code]DISCTOTAL[/code] and [code]TOTALDISCS[/code].
The number of the disc this track is on. [code]0[/code] if unknown. Read from ID3 [code]TPOS[/code] or the Vorbis comment [code]DISCNUMBER[/code].

The genre of this track. Read from ID3 [code]TCON[/code], RIFF [code]IGNR[/code] or the Vorbis comment [code]GENRE[/code]. ID3 genre codes such as [code]"(17)"[/code] or [code]"17"[/code] are converted to their name (here [code]"Rock"[/code]). Empty if unknown.

The title of this track. Read from ID3 [code]TIT2[/code] (or the ID3v1 tag), RIFF [code]INAM[/code] or the Vorbis comment [code]TITLE[/code]. Empty if unknown. To show a localized title, use it as a key, for example with [method Object.tr].

The total number of tracks of the release. [code]0[/code] if unknown. Read from the part after the slash of ID3 [code]TRCK[/code] or from the Vorbis comments [code]TRACKTOTAL[/code] and [code]TOTALTRACKS[/code].
The number of this track on the release. [code]0[/code] if unknown. Read from ID3 [code]TRCK[/code], RIFF [code]ITRK[/code] or the Vorbis comment [code]TRACKNUMBER[/code].
The release year. [code]0[/code] if unknown. Read from ID3 [code]TYER[/code] or [code]TDRC[/code], RIFF [code]ICRD[/code] or the Vorbis comment [code]DATE[/code] or [code]YEAR[/code].

signal.name: parameter_list_changed
signal.description: Signal to be emitted to notify when the parameter list changed.
